title: EXP-011 — Persistent Form Variable Definition Retention
objective: On one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form, create exactly one Form variable using the previously observed Details > Variables surface with Global=False and Persistent=True, record its exact design-time definition, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to a clean state, verify the definition still exists immediately after Save, then close only the target Form tab and reopen the exact same User-scoped Form through a previously verified supported Designer reopen path. Verify that the same variable definition is still present after reopen. This experiment concerns design-time variable-definition retention only; it must make no claim about runtime variable values, value persistence across executions, temporary-variable semantics, IDO-cache behavior, or durable storage provenance.

in_scope: Read-only preflight proving editing scope is User and the new target Form name is absent before creation.
Create exactly one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form FX_FormVariableLab01 using the verified basic-form recipe with Save Template unchecked.
Use the observed Details > Variables design-time surface on FX_FormVariableLab01.
Create exactly one variable named FX_PersistentTestVar with Global=False and Persistent=True.
Set a simple initial design-time Value of Seed-Persist-A only so the recorded definition can be compared; do not execute or mutate the value at runtime.
Record the variable definition fields visible in the Designer before Save, including Name, Global, Persistent, and Value where exposed.
Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save and verify the Designer returns to a clean state.
Verify the exact variable definition is still present immediately after Save.
Close only FX_FormVariableLab01 through its ordinary Designer Form-tab close control and verify no unsaved-change prompt.
Reopen the exact same User-scoped Form through a previously verified supported Designer reopen path such as Form-menu recent forms or Select Form.
Reopen Details > Variables and compare the variable definition with the pre-Save baseline.
Capture screenshots and read-only diagnostics under evidence/EXP-011/ and update only the EXP-011 record plus its evidence directory.
out_of_scope: Testing whether a persistent Form variable's runtime value survives Form executions, close/reopen, logout/login, or any other runtime lifecycle.
Testing whether a temporary/nonpersistent variable's runtime value disappears when a Form closes.
Regenerate Form or any second save mechanism.
Unload All Global Form Objects, IDO-metadata unloading, cache-clearing experiments, or User Preferences.
Caption, Description, component, collection, binding, validator, event handler, script, data-source, IDO-definition, localized-String, or FormSync experiments.

Modification of any existing FX_ artifact.

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Do not modify EXP-004 or any existing FX_ artifact.
Do not use Regenerate Form; use exactly one ordinary Designer Save after creating the variable.
Do not execute logic intended to read, change, or prove runtime variable-value persistence.
Do not create a Persistent=False comparison variable in this experiment.
Do not invoke Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects or any deliberate cache/metadata-clear command.
Do not open, change, or save User Preferences.
Do not create components, handlers, scripts, validators, bindings, data sources, collections, IDOs, localized Strings, or FormSync artifacts.

Do not perform login, Sign In/OK session establishment, deliberate reauthentication, logout, browser restart, or OS restart after the experiment begins; if the required session is not already usable or expires, stop and record the blocker.

acceptance_checks.description: Read-only preflight proves editing scope is User, the Mongoose session is already usable without any login/session-establishment action, and FX_FormVariableLab01 is absent exact and case-insensitive before mutation; capture evidence.

Exactly one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form named FX_FormVariableLab01 exists after creation through the verified basic-form recipe with Save Template unchecked; capture creation and inventory evidence.

Before Save, Details > Variables visibly contains exactly one experiment-created variable named FX_PersistentTestVar with Global=False, Persistent=True, and Value=Seed-Persist-A where Value is exposed; record all visible definition fields as the comparison baseline.
Exactly one ordinary Designer Save is performed after variable creation, with no Regenerate Form or second Save, and the Designer returns to a demonstrably clean state; capture clean-state evidence.

Immediately after the ordinary Save, Details > Variables still contains FX_PersistentTestVar and every recorded design-time definition field equals the AC-3 baseline; this proves post-Save definition retention for this execution.
FX_FormVariableLab01 is closed only through its ordinary Designer Form-tab close control with no unsaved-change prompt and without invoking any explicit unload/cache/metadata-clear action.

FX_FormVariableLab01 is deliberately reopened through a previously verified supported Designer reopen path, not direct cold URL navigation, and the loaded version is proven by Name + ScopeType + ScopeName to be the same User-scoped target.

After reopen, Details > Variables still contains exactly the expected FX_PersistentTestVar definition and every recorded design-time definition field equals the AC-3 baseline; capture screenshots/read-only diagnostics proving the comparison.

The experiment record explicitly classifies the result only as design-time definition retention or non-retention for the tested Global=False/Persistent=True variable and makes no runtime-value-persistence, temporary-variable, cache, or storage-provenance claim.

Final repository/worktree audit proves experiment-attributable changes are confined to the EXP-011 record and evidence/EXP-011/, with no recipe, AGENTS.md, environment, other experiment, existing FX_ artifact, or non-FX_ artifact modified.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261003-003850-ldL7. Rationale: EXP-004 established only that one Global=False/Persistent=False variable definition disappeared after the tested Designer save paths; it did not establish behavior for Persistent=True variables or runtime value persistence. The reviewed project context explicitly separates design-time definition retention from runtime value lifetime and identifies a Global=False/Persistent=True definition-retention test as the smallest next diagnostic. This is a new documented approach, not a replay or workaround of blocked EXP-004, and it tests exactly one new capability: whether a persistent Form-variable definition survives one ordinary Designer Save and an ordinary Form-tab close/reopen.
